source_text: Design a compact desktop lifting box. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A compact desktop lifting device with enclosed mechanism that enables manual lifting and lowering of an internal platform through external hand crank rotation, capable of raising the platform 80-100 mm with 1 kg payload support.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform by approximately 80-100 mm while supporting about 1 kg of payload.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm
and support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing.
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.

requirements.statement: The product must enable a user to raise and lower an internal platform by rotating an external hand crank.

verification.observable: Platform motion in response to hand crank rotation
verification.condition: Hand crank rotation produces platform lifting and lowering movement

requirements.statement: The internal platform must lift approximately 80 to 100 mm.

verification.condition: Platform moves between 80 and 100 mm from lowest to highest position

requirements.statement: The internal platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg.

verification.condition: Platform can support 1 kg load without failure

requirements.statement: The mechanism must be enclosed inside the housing.

verification.condition: All mechanical components are enclosed within housing walls

requirements.statement: The product must be safe to use.

verification.condition: Product has no exposed sharp edges, pinch points or hazardous elements

requirements.statement: The product must be mechanically plausible.

verification.condition: Design principles support stable mechanical operation

requirements.statement: The product must be easy to assemble.

verification.condition: Product can be assembled with reasonable effort and time

requirements.statement: The product must be practical to manufacture.

verification.condition: Design allows for standard manufacturing processes

requirements.statement: The product must avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.

verification.observable: Operational stability and smoothness of motion
verification.condition: Product operates smoothly without jamming or unstable behavior
Product fits within typical desktop workspace

requirements.statement: The product must operate manually only.

verification.condition: Product has no electrical or motor components

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with payload
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates hand crank to lift platform with 1 kg payload within specified range

operating_scenarios.name: Enclosure requirement
operating_scenarios.description: Mechanical components must remain enclosed within housing during operation

operating_scenarios.name: Safety and stability requirements
operating_scenarios.description: Product must operate safely without jamming or unstable behavior

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing and assembly conditions
operating_scenarios.description: Product must be manufacturable and easy to assemble
